status.description: Outcome of the mission. specs: QUESTIONS or SPEC_FINALE. review: APPROVED or CHANGES_REQUESTED. Other agents: DONE. Any agent: BLOCKED when the mission cannot be completed.

comment.description: Markdown posted in the issue for the PM, in French, plain language. specs QUESTIONS: the full question block. specs SPEC_FINALE: two lines introducing the final spec. plan, tests, code, review: what was done in 2 to 5 lines. BLOCKED: the precise cause and what the PM can do.

summary.description: One technical line for the run log, in English.

findings.description: review only: line comments posted on the pull request (path relative to the repository root, line number in the new version of the file, comment in English).
